text:
Al ver cuál vive in tormentosa lidia

Quien la cumbre tocó of la grandeza,

Bendigo my humildad and my pobreza,

Libre of the dardo of la black envidia.


La horrible ingratitud and la perfidia

No habré of lamentar; my fortaleza

La torpe adulación with his vileza

No expone a sucumbir; jamás la insidia.


Amigos fieles a estrechar my hand

Vendrán; no in pos of the esplendor of the gold

Sino of afecto fraternal and sano.


That in my modesto hogar no there is more tesoro

That aquel that guarda heart cristiano

That goza with el bien and enjuga el lloro.

translation.title: Al ver cuál vive in tormentosa lidia…
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
